assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 16:9 landscape background for an interactive island pottery mini-game, 1920x1080 composition. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: use its art quality and theme colors, do not reproduce any UI, lettering, game pottery vessel or controls. Create a dedicated beautiful ceramic atelier. Slight elevated frontal camera, warm coastal daylight. Ceramic tiles and a warm clay work surface, shelves of finished hand-made bowls and vases, three small glaze jars in muted sea teal, cream and rose, damp sponges, shaping ribbons and brushes at the outer edges. Main center from 25% to 75% width and 15% to 94% height is a calm clean EMPTY work surface for code-rendered pottery wheel and kiln animations. Edges have carefully composed authentic pottery details. No woodworking chisels, saws, wood chips, carpenter tools. No baked-in pottery wheel, no large central pot, no kiln (these animate in code), no characters, text, numbers, interface, border, watermark or logo. Entire image is one continuous room background, NOT a screenshot or asset sheet. Style/medium: elegant handcrafted pixel art matching the reference game: deliberate sharp pixel clusters, limited natural amber/terracotta/teal palette, crisp pixel texture, richly lit but readable. No blur, no photo, no smooth rendered 3D. Keep an orderly cozy working atmosphere.
